newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian overnight rates up, one week widened.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian overnight rates up, one week widened.

text.p: Egyptian pound overnight rates firmed in a typically short private-sector interbank market on Monday, bankers said.
They said overnight rates were 10 1/4 and 10 3/8 percent against Sunday's 10 and 10 1/4 percent.
The buy/sell gap on one-week rates widened, taking rates to 10 1/4 and 10 7/16 percent from 10 1/4 and 10 3/8.
"The market will start to be liquid from tomorrow (Tuesday) after results of the 91-day T-bills auction are announced and 182-day bills mature," one banker told Reuters.
The government demanded 600 million pounds worth of 91-day T-bills against the 752.800 million which will mature on Tuesday. The 91-day bills auction results will be known on Wednesday.
Public sector banks' rates were unchanged at 10 1/2 percent.
